vsm1.2:56.2: rukkhamūlikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:56.3: Tena pana rukkhamūlikena sīmantarikarukkhaṃ, cetiyarukkhaṃ, niyyāsarukkhaṃ, phalarukkhaṃ,
vsm1.2:56.4: vaggulirukkhaṃ, susirarukkhaṃ, vihāramajjhe ṭhitarukkhanti ime rukkhe vivajjetvā vihārapaccante ṭhitarukkho gahetabboti idamassa vidhānaṃ.
vsm1.2:57.2: Tattha ukkaṭṭho yathārucitaṃ rukkhaṃ gahetvā paṭijaggāpetuṃ na labhati.
vsm1.2:57.4: Majjhimo taṃ ṭhānaṃ sampattehiyeva paṭijaggāpetuṃ labhati.
vsm1.2:57.5: Mudukena ārāmikasamaṇuddese pakkositvā sodhāpetvā samaṃ kārāpetvā vālukaṃ okirāpetvā pākāraparikkhepaṃ kārāpetvā dvāraṃ yojāpetvā vasitabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:57.6: Mahadivase pana rukkhamūlikena tattha anisīditvā aññattha paṭicchanne ṭhāne nisīditabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:57.7: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi channe vāsaṃ kappitakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati.
vsm1.2:57.8: Jānitvā channe aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpitamatteti aṅguttarabhāṇakā. Ayamettha bhedo.
vsm1.2:58.1: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, rukkhamūlasenāsanaṃ nissāya pabbajjāti (mahāva. 128) vacanato nissayānurūpapaṭipattisabbhāvo, appāni ceva sulabhāni ca tāni ca anavajjānīti (a. ni. 4.27; itivu. 101) bhagavatā saṃvaṇṇitapaccayatā,
vsm1.2:59.1:
Vaṇṇito buddhaseṭṭhena, nissayoti ca bhāsito;
Nivāso pavivittassa, rukkhamūlasamo kuto.
vsm1.2:59.2:
Āvāsamaccherahare, devatā paripālite;
Pavivitte vasanto hi, rukkhamūlamhi subbato.
vsm1.2:59.3:
Abhirattāni nīlāni, paṇḍūni patitāni ca;
Passanto tarupaṇṇāni, niccasaññaṃ panūdati.
vsm1.2:59.4:
Tasmā hi buddhadāyajjaṃ, bhāvanābhiratālayaṃ;
Vivittaṃ nātimaññeyya, rukkhamūlaṃ vicakkhaṇoti.
vsm1.2:60.2: abbhokāsikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:60.3: Tassa pana abbhokāsikassa dhammassavanāya vā uposathatthāya vā uposathāgāraṃ pavisituṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:60.4: Sace paviṭṭhassa devo vassati, deve vassamāne anikkhamitvā vassūparame nikkhamitabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:60.5: Bhojanasālaṃ vā aggisālaṃ vā pavisitvā vattaṃ kātuṃ, bhojanasālāya there bhikkhū bhattena āpucchituṃ,
vsm1.2:60.6: uddisantena vā uddisāpentena vā channaṃ pavisituṃ, bahi dunnikkhittāni mañcapīṭhādīni anto pavesetuñca vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:60.7: Sace maggaṃ gacchantena vuḍḍhatarānaṃ parikkhāro gahito hoti, deve vassante maggamajjhe ṭhitaṃ sālaṃ pavisituṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:60.8: Sace na kiñci gahitaṃ hoti, sālāya ṭhassāmīti vegena gantuṃ na vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:60.9: Pakatigatiyā gantvā paviṭṭhena pana yāva vassūparamā ṭhatvā gantabbanti idamassa vidhānaṃ. Rukkhamūlikassāpi eseva nayo.
vsm1.2:61.2: Tattha ukkaṭṭhassa rukkhaṃ vā pabbataṃ vā gehaṃ vā upanissāya vasituṃ na vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:61.4: Majjhimassa rukkhapabbatagehāni upanissāya anto appavisitvā vasituṃ vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:61.5: Mudukassa acchannamariyādaṃ pabbhārampi sākhāmaṇḍapopi pīṭhapaṭopi khettarakkhakādīhi chaḍḍitā tatraṭṭhakakuṭikāpi vaṭṭatīti.
vsm1.2:61.6: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi vāsatthāya channaṃ vā rukkhamūlaṃ vā paviṭṭhakkhaṇe dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati.
vsm1.2:61.7: Jānitvā tattha aruṇaṃ uṭṭhāpitamatteti aṅguttarabhāṇakā. Ayamettha bhedo.
vsm1.2:62.2: ‘‘migā viya asaṅgacārino, aniketā viharanti bhikkhavo’’ti (saṃ. ni. 1.224) pasaṃsāya anurūpatā, nissaṅgatā, cātuddisatā, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.
vsm1.2:63.2:
Abbhokāse vasaṃ bhikkhu, migabhūtena cetasā;
Thinamiddhaṃ vinodetvā, bhāvanārāmataṃ sito.
vsm1.2:63.3:
Pavivekarasassādaṃ, nacirasseva vindati;
Yasmā tasmā hi sappañño, abbhokāsarato siyāti.
vsm1.2:64.2: sosānikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:64.3: Tena pana sosānikena yaṃ manussā gāmaṃ nivesantā ‘‘idaṃ susāna’’nti vavatthapenti, na tattha vasitabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:64.4: Na hi matasarīre ajjhāpite taṃ susānaṃ nāma hoti,
vsm1.2:64.5: jhāpitakālato pana paṭṭhāya sacepi dvādasavassāni chaḍḍitaṃ, taṃ susānameva.
vsm1.2:65.1: Tasmiṃ pana vasantena caṅkamamaṇḍapādīni kāretvā mañcapīṭhaṃ paññapetvā pānīyaparibhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā dhammaṃ vācentena na vasitabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:65.2: Garukaṃ hi idaṃ dhutaṅgaṃ, tasmā uppannaparissayavighātatthāya saṅghattheraṃ vā rājayuttakaṃ vā jānāpetvā appamattena vasitabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:65.4: Susānaṃ gacchantenāpi mahāpathā ukkamma uppathamaggena gantabbaṃ. Divāyeva ārammaṇaṃ vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:65.5: Evañhissa taṃ rattiṃ bhayānakaṃ na bhavissati, amanussā rattiṃ viravitvā viravitvā āhiṇḍantāpi na kenaci paharitabbā.
vsm1.2:65.7: Majjhimayāmaṃ susāne khepetvā pacchimayāme paṭikkamituṃ vaṭṭatīti aṅguttarabhāṇakā.
vsm1.2:66.2: Tattha ukkaṭṭhena yattha dhuvaḍāhadhuvakuṇapadhuvarodanāni atthi, tattheva vasitabbaṃ.
vsm1.2:66.3: Majjhimassa tīsu ekasmimpi sati vaṭṭati. Mudukassa vuttanayena susānalakkhaṇaṃ pattamatte vaṭṭati.
vsm1.2:66.4: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi na susānamhi vāsaṃ kappanena dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati.
vsm1.2:67.1: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso maraṇassatipaṭilābho, appamādavihāritā, asubhanimittādhigamo, kāmarāgavinodanaṃ,
vsm1.2:67.2: abhiṇhaṃ kāyasabhāvadassanaṃ, saṃvegabahulatā ārogyamadādippahānaṃ, bhayabheravasahanatā, amanussānaṃ garubhāvanīyatā, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.
vsm1.2:68.1:
Sosānikañhi maraṇānusatippabhāvā,
Niddāgatampi na phusanti pamādadosā;
Sampassato ca kuṇapāni bahūni tassa,
Kāmānubhāvavasagampi na hoti cittaṃ.
vsm1.2:68.2:
Saṃvegameti vipulaṃ na madaṃ upeti,
Sammā atho ghaṭati nibbutimesamāno;
Sosānikaṅgamitinekaguṇāvahattā,
Nibbānaninnahadayena nisevitabbanti.
vsm1.2:69.2: yathāsanthatikaṅgaṃ samādiyāmī’’ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti.
vsm1.2:69.3: Tena pana yathāsanthatikena yadassa senāsanaṃ ‘‘idaṃ tuyhaṃ pāpuṇātī’’ti gāhitaṃ hoti,
vsm1.2:70.2: Tattha ukkaṭṭho attano pattasenāsanaṃ dūreti vā accāsanneti vā amanussadīghajātikādīhi upaddutanti vā uṇhanti vā sītalanti vā pucchituṃ na labhati.
vsm1.2:70.3: Majjhimo pucchituṃ labhati. Gantvā pana oloketuṃ na labhati.
vsm1.2:70.4: Muduko gantvā oloketvā sacassa taṃ na ruccati, aññaṃ gahetuṃ labhati.
vsm1.2:70.5: Imesaṃ pana tiṇṇampi senāsanaloluppe uppannamatte dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjatīti ayamettha bhedo.
vsm1.2:71.1: Ayaṃ panānisaṃso, ‘‘yaṃ laddhaṃ tena tuṭṭhabba’’nti (jā. 1.1.136; pāci. 793) vuttovādakaraṇaṃ, sabrahmacārīnaṃ hitesitā,
vsm1.2:71.2: hīnapaṇītavikappapariccāgo, anurodhavirodhappahānaṃ, atricchatāya dvārapidahanaṃ, appicchatādīnaṃ anulomavuttitāti.
vsm1.2:72.1:
Yaṃ laddhaṃ tena santuṭṭho, yathāsanthatiko yati;
Nibbikappo sukhaṃ seti, tiṇasantharakesupi.
vsm1.2:72.2:
Na so rajjati seṭṭhamhi, hīnaṃ laddhā na kuppati;
Sabrahmacārinavake, hitena anukampati.
vsm1.2:72.3:
Tasmā ariyasatāciṇṇaṃ, munipuṅgavavaṇṇitaṃ;
Anuyuñjetha medhāvī, yathāsanthatarāmatanti.
